result.rationale: Verified in diff: parseRefreshTokenResponse sets `refreshTokenResponse.data.refresh_token = "refresh_token"` when missing, and office365calendar merges with `o365AuthCredentials = { ...o365AuthCredentials, ...tokenResponse.data }`, so the literal sentinel overwrites the real refresh token persisted to the credential, breaking future refreshes. Also the minimumTokenResponseSchema (which omits refresh_token) is used when credential sync is enabled, guaranteeing the sentinel path. Real defect.
